name: Ek Prayass
description: Ek Prayass is a student-led social welfare initiative dedicated to promoting healthier and more responsible lifestyles among students and communities. The club conducts awareness campaigns against tobacco consumption and supports underprivileged communities through educational outreach and engagement activities.

achievements.title: Community Outreach
achievements.desc: Reached and supported students in government schools across Muradnagar and Modinagar.

achievements.title: Kitabi Udaan
achievements.desc: Recycled around 1,000 notebooks and distributed them to students in need.

achievements.title: Digital Literacy
achievements.desc: Conducted digital awareness sessions covering computer basics and Microsoft Excel.

achievements.title: Health Awareness
achievements.desc: Organized anti-tobacco awareness campaigns to encourage healthier lifestyles.

events.title: Old Age Home Visit
events.desc: Visited an old age home to spend quality time with residents through conversations and interactive activities, promoting compassion and human connection.

events.title: Children's Day Celebration (Dhenda School)
events.desc: Celebrated Children's Day with notebook distribution under the 'Kitabi Udaan' initiative, along with fun activities and refreshments for students.

events.title: Computer Literacy Session (Saithli School)
events.desc: Conducted an interactive session introducing students to basic digital skills, including typing, Microsoft Excel, and computer fundamentals.

events.title: Republic Day Celebration
events.desc: Celebrated Republic Day with students in Dhendha, promoting unity, patriotism, and community engagement.
